newsitem.title: FINLAND: HACKMAN SEES 1997 PROFIT FOR OP UNITS.
newsitem.headline: HACKMAN SEES 1997 PROFIT FOR OP UNITS.

text.p: Finnish counsumer goods group Oy Hackman Ab on Thursday said it expected its operating units to report full-year 1997 profits.

"A continuing trend in line with the first four months for the remaining part of the year will give a positive result for the operating units in 1997," Hackman said in a statement with its January-April results.
In 1996, Hackman posted a loss before extraordinary items and tax of 23.6 million markka while it had an operating profit of 20.6 million markka.
Most of its units' orderbacklogs had improved from the start of the year, Hackman said.
